notes.title: Éalú launches Oct 2nd, 2:30pm PST / 5:30pm EST / 9:30pm GMT, 10:30pm IST!
notes.content: [p]Almost there!! Our team is on time, ready for launch and so excited to share what we've made with everyone! Since our dev team is spread across multiple time zones, we wanted to find a time where we would all be awake and away from our day jobs to be online together when we click the button and release Éalú to the world! It's a bit of an odd time of day to release a game, but hey - we're a bit of an odd bunch! [/p][p][/p][p]Éalú will go live on October 2nd, 2025 at:[/p][p][/p][p]2:30pm Pacific Time[/p][p]3:30pm Mountain Time[/p][p]4:30pm Central Time[/p][p]5:30pm Eastern Time[/p][p][/p][p]9:30pm GMT[/p][p]10:30pm Irish Time[/p][p][/p][p]We can't wait for October!![/p]

notes.title: Dublin ComiCon was amazing!
notes.content: [p]We had an absolutely fantastic time at Dublin ComiCon!!! We really appreciate all of the people who came and either said hello, played the game or both.[/p][p][/p][p]In addition to the overwhelming positive feedback people shared, we noticed a few ways we can polish the game even further and will be applying those changes as we prepare for launch. [/p][p][/p][p]It was a privilege to be there among so many other game developers creating wildly creative & fun new games! Here's hoping we can manage to bring Éalú to another event soon, maybe this time on the East Coast of the USA closer to where our developer, Ben, lives![/p][p][/p][p]For those who were able to join us this time, what did you think?[/p][p][/p][p]Also, if you have any questions for us, let us know![/p]

notes.title: Éalú exhibiting at Dublin ComiCon Aug 9th & 10th!
notes.content: [p]Éalú's core dev team, Ivan Fisher-Owen (animator) and Ben Orr (developer), will be exhibiting the game in person at Dublin ComiCon on August 9th and 10th. [/p][p][/p][p]We've been thrilled to hear from some folks already that they'll be stopping by our table to say hello and try out a preview of our game in person! We'll also have a diorama of one of the sets & mouse puppets from the game on display for people to check out in real life. [/p][p][/p][p]We'll be on the 2nd floor, in the game dev room from open to close both days.[/p][p][/p][p]Hope to see you there![/p]

notes.title: My heart's already been stolen by this stop-motion adventure made out of wood and 'mostly in a garden shed'
notes.content: Éalú, from first time developers Beyond the Bark, starts with a strong premise: You are a mechanical mouse looking to escape a mysterious labyrinth. But its presentation is what really blows the doors down: Nearly everything is made out of wood, and rendered in full-on, stop-motion animation... Read more.
